On the second trip, Joma allegedly drove off with three aliens in her car before returning alone to the courthouse for work.

Charged with RAPING A 16-YEAR-OLD GIRL in Huntington June 6, we lodged a detainer asking sanctuary New York to not release Salvadoran illegal alien Aureliano Antonio Melendez Reyes from jail.

The girl was walking home when Reyes allegedly approached her and asked for her phone number. After she refused, he allegedly forced her into an alley and sexually assaulted her.

She eventually managed to break free and called 911 as she ran from him, even while he was still pursuing her. Police arrived on the scene and took him into custody.

An immigration judge issued a final removal order way back in 1988. Reyes is now charged with rape, sexual abuse, and endangering the welfare of a child.

We lodged an immigration detainer on Mexican illegal alien Felix Jeronimo-Rojas, who was sentenced to five years in prison June 17 for robbing and raping the corpse of a man who died on a New York City subway in 2025.

If honored by the sanctuary city, our detainer will prevent Jeronimo-Rojas from being released back into the community at some point.

The victim was 37-year-old Jorge Gonzalez, who lost consciousness and died on a bench in the subway car. About three hours later, Jeronimo-Rojas boarded the car and, upon noticing that Gonzalez was unconscious, began sexually assaulting his corpse while rummaging through his pockets.

He turned himself in to authorities three weeks later — after surveillance footage of the incident was circulated.

He previously illegally entered the country FOUR times in 1998 and 1999, voluntarily returning to Mexico each time after encountering U.S. Border Patrol. He then illegally entered the country for a FIFTH time at an unknown date and location.

39-year-old Mexican citizen Abelardo Sanchez, who had been living in Ireland and fled to Austria, made his first court appearance June 8 in McAllen, Texas for allegedly producing child sexual abuse material. 

ICE HSI special agents uncovered and traced to Sanchez an online account dating back to 2014 that contained CSAM. 

Investigators also identified a child victim living in Texas at the time Sanchez produced his images.

Sanchez faces up to 50 years in prison and a maximum fine of $250,000 if convicted.

➡️Get details about this ongoing case in our newsroom.

📊 ICE arrested 735 criminal illegal aliens in the Houston area in May who accounted for 1,711 criminal convictions, including 625 aliens who were convicted of at least one criminal offense that killed, harmed or otherwise put the lives of innocent Americans in danger. 

Twenty-five of the aliens arrested were members or associates of some of the most brutal transnational and prison gangs in the world, including MS-13, Surenos 13, 18th Street, Tango Blast, Paisas, Chucos Tangos, Southwest Cholos, Brown and Proud, and La Primera.

Romanian national and criminal illegal alien Marius Catalin Trica was sentenced for bank fraud late last month after an ICE @HSILosAngeles-led probe disrupted a Romanian transnational criminal organization.

Tricia and his co-conspirators imported skimming devices and IDs before installing them on credit card machines at retail stores.

They supported their U.S. lifestyles by using cloned cards with New York victims’ EBT account numbers, withdrawing cash from ATMs in Los Angeles.

📸Trica tried to illegally enter the U.S. multiple times, most recently in a Mexican ambulance with fake injuries in June 2025 — but he was apprehended.

ICE HSI arrested Felipe Linares de Oliveira Dell Aquilla June 5 in Mooresville, N.C., during a targeted operation after officials learned he was holding his wife against her will as he plotted an escape to Mexico. His arrest followed a vehicle pursuit that ended in a crash. 

🔎Dell Aquilla is a citizen of Brazil who is wanted in his home nation on charges of criminal association and extortion. He previously served as a commander within two Brazil-based criminal foreign terrorist organizations. 

⚖️He was transported to the county jail and is charged with fleeing to evade arrest. ICE is pursuing federal charges for kidnapping and a weapons offense.  
 
ICE appreciates the support from the Iredell County Sheriff’s Office and the Mooresville Police Department during this operation.
